system.description: Closed Essence 14.3.2 - Counterspells. Spells to study and detect spells and spelltraps, embed counterspells and spelltraps on a target, and reflect or reverse an incoming spell.

This spell allows the caster to study one spell for use with the other spells on this list. For a spell to be studied, the caster must cast this spell within 1 minute of the time the target spell was cast, and must concentrate for one round per level of the studied spell. A caster can only have one spell 'studied' per level of experience.

Detects the presence of any counterspells on a target. Has a 50% chance of revealing what spell by which the counterspell will be triggered. Multiple casts of this spell on a target will reveal no additional information.

When casting this spell on the target, the caster must specify one first level spell to be counterspelled. The spell to be counterspelled must either be known by the caster or have been previously studied (using the Study Spell on this list). If the specified spell is later cast on that target, that spell will have no effect, and this counterspell is dispelled. At any one time, a target can only have one level of counterspells per level of experience. Each Counterspell I counts as 1 spell level, each Counterspell III counts as 3 spell levels, etc.

Detects the presence of any spelltraps on a target. Has a 50% chance of revealing what spell by which the spelltrap will be triggered. Multiple casts of this spell on a target will reveal no additional information.
As Counterspell I, except that if the specified spell is cast on the target, the target will gain a number of PP equal to the level of the countered spell.

As Counterspell I, except that three levels of spells are countered. This can be a specific third level spell or a specific second and a specific first level spell or three specific first level spells. Note that the three first level spells can be the same spell, so if that spell is cast on the target repeatedly it can be countered more than once.

Any Counterspells or Spelltraps on the target have a chance of disintegrating with no effect. Each counterspell or spelltrap should roll a resistance roll at +25. Failure results in the dispelling of the failing counterspell or spelltrap.
As Counterspell III, except affects 4 levels.
As Spelltrap I, except that up to 3 levels may be trapped.
As Counterspell III, except affects 5 levels.
As Spelltrap III, except 5 levels can be trapped.
As Counterspell III, except affects 8 levels.

This spell may be cast in conjunction with any Counterspell. If the specific spell selected is cast on the target, the spell is reflected back upon its caster. Treat the caster as the target of the spell in all ways.
As Reflect Essence, except affects Channeling spells.
As Reflect Essence, except affects Mentalism spells.
As Spelltrap III, except 10 levels can be trapped.
As Countermeasures, except resistance rolls are made at no modification (+0).
As Counterspell III, except affects 15 levels.
As Spelltrap III, except 15 levels can be trapped.

When this spell is cast, the target spell must make a RR (target level is the level of spell) or be reversed. A reversed spell will have the opposite effect it was intended to have. For example, elemental attack spells that heal hits and wounds, Hold will Haste the target, Curses will Bless, etc. The exact nature of this reversal is up to the GM. If there is no appropriate reverse effect, the spell is merely canceled.
As Counterspell III, except affects 20 levels.
As Lord Counterspell, except affects the specified spells that target anyone or anything inside a 10'R around a point touched. This point may be on an object that can be moved.
As Spelltrap III, except 20 levels can be trapped.
